correctness.rationale: The twelve explicit inequalities are all facets of a full-dimensional order polytope; their primitive normals form a totally unimodular directed incidence matrix. Therefore a normal cone is smooth exactly when its active edge graph is a forest. A cycle argument proves exactly six four-cycle and one six-cycle inclusion-minimal singular cones; the faces are six lattice square pyramids and one primitive segment. Saturated circuit quotient lattices give 2×2 and 3×3 Segre determinantal transverse cones, multiplicities 2 and 6. The standalone actual packaged checker exhaustively verifies all 18,563 square minors, 403 faces, 96 singular orbits, seven components and component incidence. Characteristic-free toric arguments complete the proof. Scheme-theoretic singular ideals are not claimed.
